texts.facts: 2. By order dated 19.06.2019, learned APP was directed to take instructions from the Investigating Officer in respect of the antecedents of the applicant. Though the co-accused has disclosed the name of the present applicant, however, there is no further connecting evidence as against the applicant. Learned APP, on instructions, submits that the Investigating Officer has taken search in various police stations, including the police station at Bhokardan. However, no crime has been registered against the applicant anywhere. It thus appears that the antecedents of the Arshad S/O.
